description: Look up an E_/W_ diagnostic code in the catalogue: what it means, why it is raised and how to resolve it, with an example that raises it and, for most codes when the installed core has them, `fixed`, the same example corrected. Returns { ok:true, code, entry: { code, severity, message, cause, fix, example, fixed? } }, the `explain --json` of the CLI; an unknown code returns { ok:false, code }. The code is matched case-insensitively.

code.description: A diagnostic code, e.g. E_ROOM_SIZE or W_DOOR_CLEARANCE.

name: explain
title: Explain a diagnostic code
